story: Lena's chest-pain workup at John Muir Walnut Creek (CT angiogram, troponins, ECG), real John Muir prices. Insured, single, about 515% of the poverty line: no charity discount. The bill ignores her insurance and charges the CT angiogram above John Muir's posted price. Also a double charge in her bank.
